question: Who Owns Five Guys?
quick_answer: Five Guys is privately owned by the Murrell family, who founded it in 1986 in Arlington, Virginia. The 'five guys' are founder Jerry Murrell's sons, and the family has kept the company private, so it does not trade on a stock exchange. It expanded through franchising while staying family-controlled.
key_facts: Founded by Jerry Murrell and his family
The 'five guys' are Jerry Murrell's sons
Privately owned by the Murrell family

body.heading: Who owns Five Guys?
body.text: Five Guys is owned by the Murrell family, who have kept it private since it started. There are no public shares in Five Guys, and the company has stayed family-controlled rather than selling to an investment group or going public.

body.heading: Where the name comes from
body.text: Jerry Murrell and his wife started Five Guys in 1986 in Arlington, Virginia. The 'five guys' were originally Jerry and his four sons who were part of the business. After a fifth son was born, Jerry said the 'five guys' were now his five sons. Either way, the name refers to the Murrell family, who focused on a simple menu of fresh burgers, fries and free peanuts, cooked to order.

body.heading: Growth through franchising
body.text: Five Guys grew quickly in the 2000s by franchising while the Murrell family kept ownership and control of the brand. That lets the company expand widely while staying privately held rather than becoming a public company.
